nom: WELEDA - Skin Food Soin nourrissant (texture légère) - Pour les peaux sèches et agressées - Hydrate la peau instantanément - NATRUE* - 30 ml

avis.texte: Crème hydratante, pas trop épaisse, pénètre vite et laisse la peau hydratée toute la journée moi qui ai la peau sèche
Esse hidratante é maravilhoso. Tenho pele do rosto mista, seca em algumas partes e sensível, hidratada muito bem e não deu alergias.

I’ve started using this as my main skin care routine for my face, it’s going great. I was using a few L’Oréal products but I can’t really see a difference between results. I don’t wear foundation, so I can’t comment on how it sits over that. It does feel light, my skin can be quite oily but this feels just right, I don’t think my skin would like the not light version. It feels nice to put on and seems to last. I also really love the fact it rates well on the Yuka app. I like it so much I’ve bought some for a friend and I’m also looking at getting the eye cream too.
